cadence: IPMDAR profile only: actual CDRL reporting at least monthly; same reporting/accounting period across components; reports after period close and no later than sixteen business days after period end, with applicable incremental Detailed Analysis final date. Selected Table 2.2 staffing/subcontractor items follow the CDRL Block 16 selection and individual frequency. Program/Management/DE plans use the actual contract/CDRL schedule; no uninspected universal update cadence is invented.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Envelope. Names the selected source/profile and receiver format. A projection format does not waive native deliverable requirements.

fields.name: completeness
fields.description: Envelope. Uses partial-example, partial-extract, or complete-submission. A partial flag never represents acceptance of a complete source deliverable.

fields.name: invocation
fields.description: Envelope. Actual contract/CDRL applicability, source editions, tailoring, reportingFrequency, tailoredItems, submission role, format agreement and applicable reference editions. An illustrative invocation is not an actual contract. Covered source logical field names: applicableCdrlRequirements, invocation.reportingFrequency, invocation.tailoredItems, referenceDocumentIssues, tailoringPlaceholders.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Envelope. Controlled origin, scope, source-to-receiver mapping and authoritative WBS/requirement join targets. Retains all supplied operative context; excludes guidance catalogues.

fields.name: records
fields.description: Envelope. Non-empty received role/responsibility or staffing records; no fixed production row count. The sample alone has exactly three rows.

fields.name: nativeDelivery
fields.description: Envelope. Actual native delivered payloads and attachments, including the complete received CPD ZIP bytes or agreed DEMP document/model where applicable. attachments carries mediaType and contentBase64 containing canonical unbroken RFC 4648 base64 bytes, not merely filenames/URLs or a precomputed digest. This receiving representation is not a mandated native format. Covered source logical field names: agreedFormat, attachmentIdentifiers, attachmentTextReferences, document, model, nativeFormat.

fields.name: recordId
fields.description: Each record. Stable, non-empty receiver identifier; a receiver rule, not a source-prescribed syntax.

fields.name: wbsId
fields.description: Each record. Required, non-empty WBS join resolving to an authoritative receiver target; chosen receiver rule. Preserve native source WBS IDs and hierarchies separately.

fields.name: requirementId
fields.description: Each record. Required, non-empty requirement join resolving to an authoritative receiver target; chosen receiver rule, not a DID-created requirement allocation mandate.

fields.name: securityMarking
fields.description: Each record. Received security marking and controlling context. Source-document Distribution A does not authorize release of delivered personnel/program data. PMP nativeFormat/classification is unclassified; actual marking/CUI determinations remain separate. Covered source logical field names: classification, securityClassification, securityMarking.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Each record or shared source context as mapped. Negotiated work, AUW, organizational/task scope and applicable plan boundaries. Required whenever the selected source clause applies. Covered source logical field names: scope.

fields.name: sourceMetadata
fields.description: Received complete source heading/identity/version/period and source-to-record provenance. Native contractor/contract/program metadata is retained when supplied; the sample invents no actual contract number. Covered source logical field names: contractOrProcurementRequestIdentification, sourceMetadata, systemComponentProgramProjectIdentification.

fields.name: sourceEvidence
fields.description: Complete operative received source data and data-product content underlying the projection, not a selected-field or ID-only summary. Includes native CPD table data/type metadata and full reference fieldsets needed by applicable constraints; received bytes belong in nativeDelivery. Contains no guidance-only fields. Covered source logical field names: costData, scheduleData, sourceEvidence, technicalData.

fields.name: roleAssignments
fields.description: Non-empty when the selected profile reports roles/responsibilities. Retains actual source organization titles/names, functions/duties, personnel position requirements, assigned-person background, task skill type/level/headcount/clearance and proposal-only availability/hiring data as applicable. DEMP RACI uses Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed only for the invoked DE-specific profile; no universal one-accountable/one-responsible cardinality is imposed. Retains DE organization-chart and IMS resource-allocation links without inferring a numeric allocation absent source data. Covered source logical field names: assignedPersonnelBackground, assignedPersonnelIdentity, assignedPersonnelWorkExperience, availablePersonnelCount, corporateResponsibilities, deRaciMatrix, deStakeholderResponsibilities, deStakeholderRoles, imsRoleResourceAllocations, managementOfficeStaffing, positionClearance, positionEducation, positionExperience, positionSkills, positionTraining, requiredPersonnelCount, requiredSecurityClearance, responsibilities, skillLevel, skillType.

fields.name: staffingHours
fields.description: CPD hours and associated metric metadata: BCWS/BCWP/ACWP/ETC, cost element, CA/WP grain, reporting period, cumulative/time-phased basis, reprogramming data and supplied dollars where required. Unit is explicit; hours are not silently converted into personnel counts or FTE. Required only under the applicable staffing source/profile. Covered source logical field names: staffingHours.

fields.name: reportingPeriodId
fields.description: Preserves the source reporting-period identifier and alignment across applicable IPMDAR components; not a receiver-invented calendar period. Covered source logical field names: reportingPeriodId.

fields.name: reportingCalendar
fields.description: Native periods, inclusive start/end dates and working hours across baseline/forecast, preserving native ordering and conditional scope. FFS inclusive bounds and DEI exclusive periods require disjoint contiguous periods: StartDate is no later than EndDate and each next StartDate is the previous EndDate plus one day. WorkingHours is nonnegative. Covered source logical field names: reportingCalendar.

fields.name: wbs
fields.description: Native WBS/CWBS identifiers, hierarchy, commonBase or planning-equivalent basis, relationship, element descriptions and associated costs where required. Receiver wbsId joins do not replace the native tree or resolve unstated equivalence mappings. Covered source logical field names: commonBase, cwbsElementCost, cwbsElementDescription, cwbsRelationship, wbs.

fields.name: organizations
fields.description: Native organization data/OBS, programOrganizationChart with organizationTitle/organizationName, programOffice/supportContractors/majorSubcontractors, and functionalOrganizationRelationshipChart with programFunctions/functionalOrganizations/authorityLines/communicationLines. Preserve the two PMP charts and relevant management-plan charts as distinct content, even when a chosen representation shares nodes. Covered source logical field names: authorityLines, communicationLines, corporateOrganizationChart, corporateOrganizationNarrative, functionalOrganizationRelationshipChart, functionalOrganizations, majorSubcontractors, managementOfficeOrganizationChart, organization, organizationChartRoleLinks, organizationName, organizationTitle, organizations, programFunctions, programOffice, programOrganizationChart, supportContractors.

fields.name: controlAccounts
fields.description: Native control-account and summary-level planning-package structure, separate types and exact applicable WBS/OBS terminal-element mappings. Covered source logical field names: controlAccounts.

fields.name: workPackages
fields.description: Native work/planning-package identities, type distinctions and control-account trace; only required at the contract-selected grain. Covered source logical field names: workPackages.

fields.name: subcontractors
fields.description: Applicable native major-subcontractor/EVM-flow-down identity and relationship data; not an automatic requirement for subcontractors absent source applicability. Covered source logical field names: subcontractors.

fields.name: staffingNarrative
fields.description: Received searchable human-readable PNR content and native document bytes, including selected staffing changes/reasons/projection risks/impacts and selected major-subcontractor changes. CDRL Block 16 selection and frequency are preserved; no unselected Table 2.2 narrative is made mandatory. Covered source logical field names: staffingNarrative.

fields.name: approval
fields.description: Only actual required signatures, attestation and evidence; no signature or approval is inferred from ingestion or hashing. Covered source logical field names: approval.

fields.name: proprietaryDisclosure
fields.description: Actual company proprietary disclosure statement and required placements across PNR/signature page, CPD and SPD when the IPMDAR source applies. Covered source logical field names: proprietaryDisclosure.

fields.name: delivery
fields.description: Actual delivery endpoint, timing, source period close, business-day basis, incremental final date and subcontractor-to-prime relation as applicable. Preserves source context without inventing a contract cadence for plans. Covered source logical field names: delivery.

fields.name: managementPlanContent
fields.description: Remaining received operative management-plan fieldsets needed for the selected F10 duties: managementPractices, managementTechniques, subcontractorManagement, organizational/control narratives, resource assumptions, reporting approach, content structure and required format/tailoring metadata. Preserve all supplied operative content. F10 does not claim to extract every complete PMP/Management Plan/DEMP section. Covered source logical field names: authority, binding, contractualTask, controlLines, corporateFunctionalRelationships, dataDeliveryManagementMethods, deImplementationAssumptions, deImplementationConstraints, digitalEnvironmentHardware, digitalEnvironmentNetworks, digitalEnvironmentSoftware, digitalEnvironmentTools, digitalEnvironmentWorkforce, functionalRelationships, governmentInterfaces, index, issuingGovernmentActivity, legibility, maintenanceUpdateApproach, managementOfficeNarrative, managementPractices, managementTechniques, otherContractorInterfaces, pageSequence, paragraphNumbers, preparingOfficeOrContractorTitle, reproducibility, requiredNewHireCount, sectionNumbers, stakeholderTrainingPlan, subcontractorManagement, tableOfContents.

markings: PMP §2 requires an unclassified plan; DI-MGMT-81861C excludes classified submissions to EVM-CR. Neither condition means publicly releasable or free of CUI. canonicalForm: Hash the complete received operative payload with exactly these envelope keys: profile, completeness, invocation, context, records, nativeDelivery. Each record uses named record fields in this contract; exact native nested content and all actual delivered bytes remain in sourceEvidence/managementPlanContent/nativeDelivery rather than being dropped by projection. No guidance catalogue or guidance-only field enters the payload. Reject unknown envelope/direct-record keys, duplicate keys, or collisions after normalization. Normalize every object key and string to Unicode NFC, trim Unicode White_Space, and collapse each sequence of Unicode White_Space to one U+0020. Unicode White_Space is U+0009–000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000–200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F and U+3000. Sort records by normalized recordId in Unicode code-point order and reject duplicate recordId values; preserve all other array order. Sort object keys by Unicode code-point order. Reject unpaired Unicode surrogates in keys and values. Serialize compact JSON with this exact string escaping: double quotation mark and backslash are escaped; U+0008, U+0009, U+000A, U+000C and U+000D use the standard short JSON b, t, n, f and r escapes; remaining U+0000 through U+001F controls use lowercase hexadecimal Unicode escapes of the form backslash-u00xx; slash and all other Unicode characters are literal. Use null/true/false literals, and exact finite decimal numbers in plain notation with no exponent, no unnecessary trailing fractional zeros or decimal point, and zero for negative zero; never round through binary floating point. Before string normalization, validate each original nativeDelivery.attachments[].contentBase64 value as canonical unbroken RFC 4648 base64: reject whitespace or invalid alphabet/padding and require exact equality with the canonical re-encoding of the decoded bytes. The complete byte representation is part of the serialized payload, not replaced by identifiers or hashes. Finally apply Unicode NFC, trim, and the same Unicode-White_Space collapse to the serialized JSON, encode UTF-8, and compute SHA-256. A production baseline hashes all received operative content under its actual invocation, including native evidence and attachments, not merely these three records or their selected fields.
